usage.title: User data usage
usage.lead: Space used by each user (1 GB each), largest first; public originals count for nobody.
usage.subject: User

vocabulary.title: Vocabulary
vocabulary.lead: The shared vocabulary for describing material (SDD 0049). It lives in code and carries a version.
vocabulary.rule: Adding types or values keeps the version; renaming, deleting or changing meaning bumps it, regenerates the contract, and old descriptions need reconfirming. Change it through a code commit, not here.

materials.title: Disabled material
materials.lead: Find material, disable it (violations) or purge it lawfully. Each step records a reason and a deletion event.
materials.needFilter: Give an owner, an id, or tick “Disabled only”.
materials.disableConfirm: Disabling stops all new reads and revokes running grants. Continue?
materials.personalInfo: Content is personal information that must be deleted
materials.purgeConfirm: Purging deletes originals and readings (if others still lawfully use it and it is not personal information, only the owner relation is removed). Continue?
materials.relationOnly: Others still use it lawfully; only the owner relation was removed.
materials.actionFailed: That did not work; please retry.
materials.adminOnly: Only admins can disable or purge.
